brand.name: SCOOT Eyewear
brand.description: Independent eyewear inspired by vintage scooter culture, timeless silhouettes, and personalized custom designs.
brand.whatsapp_message_template: Halo SCOOT EYEWEAR, saya ingin bertanya.

design_system.style: Monochrome identity, editorial fashion, vintage scooter culture, brutalist minimal.

rules: Headings must be bold and impactful, often uppercase.
Use mono fonts for small technical details or labels if needed to add an editorial edge.

design_system.spacing: Generous padding and margins (p-8 to p-24). Use large gaps (gap-8, gap-12) between grid items.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none), bg-black text-white or border border-black text-black, uppercase, hover:bg-gray-900.
components.cards: No visible card containers. Images stretch to container width. Minimalist text below images.
components.inputs: Sharp corners (rounded-none), border-gray-300, focus:border-black focus:ring-1 focus:ring-black.
components.badges: Sharp edges, uppercase, small text, border border-black.

sections: Hero Carousel: 3 slides with full-bleed images, text overlay ('RIDE YOUR OWN STYLE', 'Monochrome identity', 'Vintage soul. Modern vision.', 'Colorful culture. Your own way.').
Featured Collection ('Koleksi unggulan'): Grid of 4 products (Brill, Ocala, Casama, Brazz).
Custom Print Banner ('MAKE IT YOURS'): Split layout. Image of glasses temple on one side, text and CTA on the other.
About Us Teaser ('MORE THAN JUST EYEWEAR'): Text heavy editorial block.
Gallery ('Lihat lebih dekat'): Grid of 3 editorial images.

katalog.layout: Two-column layout on desktop: Sidebar (1/4 width) and Product Grid (3/4 width).
katalog.sidebar: Filters: 'CARI MODEL' (Search input), 'MODEL' (Checkbox list), 'WARNA BINGKAI' (Checkbox list), 'HARGA POLOS' (Radio list).
katalog.main: Top bar with sorting dropdown ('Terbaru', 'Harga terendah', 'Harga tertinggi'). Grid of products (3 cols desktop, 2 cols mobile).
katalog.product_card: Image, Category ('SCOOT ORIGINALS'), Name, Price, 'PILIH WARNA BINGKAI'. Hover effect shows secondary image or subtle zoom.

product_detail.layout: Split screen on desktop. Left: Scrollable stack of large product images. Right: Sticky product information.

details.variants: Radio group for 'Kacamata polos' (Base price) vs 'Custom print' (+Rp15.000).
details.custom_form: If 'Custom print' is selected, show: 'Tulisan custom' (Text input), 'Unggah logo' (File input), 'Catatan tambahan' (Textarea).
details.actions: Quantity selector (- / +), 'TAMBAH KE KERANJANG' button, 'TANYA VIA WHATSAPP' button.
details.accordions: Informasi produk, Paket custom print, Informasi pemesanan.

sections: Hero: 'MAKE IT YOURS' with large image of glasses temple.
Info: Explanation of +Rp15.000 cost and what is included.
Steps: 4-step grid (Pilih model, Pilih custom, Tulis cirimu, Kirim pesanan).

keranjang.layout: Cart items list on left, Order summary on right.
keranjang.features: Update quantity, remove item. Show custom print details if applicable. Subtotal calculation. 'Checkout via WhatsApp' button that generates a formatted message.

tentang_kami.content: Editorial layout. 'Style is personal. Culture is timeless.' 3 pillars: Independent, Timeless, Custom.

grosir.content: Information for orders > 100 pcs. 3 steps: Bagikan kebutuhanmu, Dapatkan penawaran, Konfirmasi pesanan. WhatsApp CTA.

panduan_produk.content: Static page with product care and sizing information.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully functional React frontend mimicking the exact layout and design of the reference site.
Use Tailwind CSS for styling. Ensure all components use sharp corners (rounded-none) to match the editorial, brutalist monochrome aesthetic.
Implement the catalog with functional filtering (by model, color, price) and sorting.
Implement the product detail page with a sticky right column and scrollable left image gallery.
Implement the custom print form on the product page (conditional fields when 'Custom print' variant is selected).
Implement a functional cart using React context or Zustand, with a checkout button that formats the order into a WhatsApp message link.
Ensure the navigation is sticky and changes background on scroll.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
Create all 9 pages as specified in the 'pages' object.
Use the provided image URLs for products and campaigns.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements.
Do not use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or sticky headers without backdrop blur.
Do not center align the app container.
Use modern button styles with interaction animations.
